shared: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE ancient Chinese tactical equipment inventory icon. First reference is the FULL ORIGINAL EQUIPMENT ATLAS: use it only for historical object vocabulary, not its detailed surface style or grid arrangement. Second reference is approved broad-matte STYLE ONLY: thick dark outline, exaggerated chunky silhouette, huge calm uninterrupted painted planes and two broad light/shadow tones per material. Native destination 48x48, so simplify aggressively. Use only TWO main tones per material, no secondary tiny facets. No stipple, mottling, mosaic, scratches, grain, glossy rendering, gradients, tiny ornamental lines or glitter. Oblique three-quarter overhead game view. One compact group centered in a square canvas, about 80 percent fill, full objects with clear margins. Genuine transparent alpha outside and through gaps. No background, ground, cast shadow, checkerboard, text, labels, UI frame or characters. Do not reproduce atlas.

assets.subject: Subject: 架桥营主装备组, ancient Chinese military bridge-building equipment. ONE short wide three-plank wooden footbridge panel tied onto two thick crossbeams, with ONE large simple tan rope coil resting beside its lower corner. Clearly a construction panel, not a complete bridge scene. Thick flat ochre wood slabs with only two smooth color planes each, no woodgrain, no railing, no terrain, no water, no person. Compact diagonal arrangement.
assets.identity: Bridge-building engineering role reconstructed using full atlas bridge panel and rope vocabulary, not exact legacy slot recovery.

assets.subject: Subject: 火铳手主装备组, ancient Chinese hand-cannon soldier equipment.
